scripts.studio:dev: npm run tauri -w @fluenta/desktop -- dev --features studio --config src-tauri/tauri.studio.conf.json
scripts.studio:build: npm run tauri -w @fluenta/desktop -- build --features studio --config src-tauri/tauri.studio.conf.json
scripts.contracts: cargo run -p fluenta-contracts --bin export && node scripts/contracts.mjs
scripts.content:build: cargo run -p fluenta-content --bin content-build -- content/foundation apps/desktop/src-tauri/resources/courses
scripts.check: python scripts/test-release.py && node scripts/contracts.mjs --check && npm run build && npm run studio:ui:build -w @fluenta/desktop && cargo test --workspace --all-features && cargo clippy --workspace --all-targets --all-features -- -D warnings
scripts.format: cargo fmt --all && prettier --write apps/desktop/src apps/studio/src packages/contracts scripts/*.mjs
